title: Lamb Spanakopita Spring Rolls
description: Crispy spring rolls filled with lamb and spinach, a unique fusion of Greek and Chinese flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the soy sauce, ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
4. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted.
6. Lay a spring roll wrapper on a clean surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the lamb mixture in the center of the wrapper.
7. Brush the edges of the wrapper with water and fold the bottom half of the wrapper up over the filling.
8. Fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
9. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
10. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
11. When the oil is hot, add a few of the spring rolls and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
12. Drain the spring rolls on paper towels and serve hot.
